Write-path half PARTIALLY FAILS: src/duckdb/queries.ts:12 imports getNamespaceWriter and :868 calls getNamespaceWriter(target.ns, writerOptions).enqueue({...}) with the op mapping at lines 871-875 (tombstone->delete, update->update, else insert) — TRUE; src/http/routes/tables.ts:50 import + :764 enqueue({op:'insert'}) — TRUE; src/mcp/tools/remember.ts:19 import + :315 enqueue with the same op mapping — TRUE. The criterion's explicit claim that getNamespaceWriter is 'imported by src/cli/http.ts' is factually false at HEAD, so the stated spec surface is not fully re-verified. (Verification-only aspect is consistent: `git diff --stat` shows only .gitreins/tasks.yaml changed, 13 insertions/11 deletions, no code change.)
The six spec-named suites genuinely pass 31/31 at HEAD and the serializer write path is wired in queries.ts/tables.ts/remember.ts, but the criterion's claim that getNamespaceWriter is imported by src/cli/http.ts is false (0 occurrences; http.ts only imports setSerializerAuthorizationHook and mounts the routes indirectly), so the stated spec surface is not fully verified.
